Let me consider the historical facts about the Internet's origins.

The Internet originated from ARPANET (Advanced Research Projects Agency Network), which was developed by the United States Department of Defense's ARPA in the late 1960s. The first ARPANET link was established between UCLA and Stanford Research Institute in California in 1969. The fundamental protocols that define the Internet (TCP/IP) were also developed in the United States in the 1970s and 1980s.

Switzerland is home to CERN, where Tim Berners-Lee invented the World Wide Web in 1989-1991, but the Web is a service that runs on top of the Internet - it is not the Internet itself. This is a common point of confusion.
